verdict.rationale: Porkbun runs its own default nameservers. It documents full CRUD over a broad set of record types (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SRV, CAA, TLSA, SSHFP, ALIAS, HTTPS, SVCB) plus DNSSEC DS records. Community users describe the UI as minimalist, fast-loading and less frustrating than Namecheap, though one calls it barebones. Missing for 10: any evidence on minimum or low TTL support, an explicit statement that DNS hosting is included free with every domain, and hands-on evidence about the DNS editor UI specifically rather than the site overall.
